steps.speaker: Primrose
steps.content: A-a newcomer?

Désir is an idyllic town alive with greenery and winding paths. Neat brick houses line the streets, each with cozy gardens, lounge chairs, and teapot-topped tables. This is a place meant for leisurely tea-sipping, yet at this moment, every townsfolk's gaze is fixed on the new visitor.

steps.speaker: Townie A
steps.content: Whoa, look at your coat, it's barely holding together! Must've been a rough journey, huh? You didn't come with the caravan, did you? Finding this place on your own is no small feat. Those desert bandits and monsters out there aren't exactly welcoming to travelers.
It wasn't too bad. I got lucky and didn't run into any real trouble...

steps.speaker: Townie B
steps.content: Hey now, what's with the grilling? You're almost like those trigger-happy DisCity border guards! Help our guest set down, shall we? Look, we don't stand on ceremony here in Désir. Make yourself at home. Right there's the diner and bakery, and a bit further down, you'll find the general store and post office. Oh, and over there...
Before you can even catch your breath, the townsfolk crowd around you, curious but welcoming.

steps.speaker: Liam
steps.content: Welcome! Yes, you are in Désir! I'm Liam, and this is Primrose!
Liam emerges from behind the bread basket. He drags the startled girl forward, squeezing through the crowd.

The mellow sunlight filters through the square, mingling with the sweet scent of datura blossoms and the cheerful chatter of the townspeople. It's a scene of peacefulness, almost like a paradise in the unforgiving WhiteSands. It looks nothing like a "smugglers den" it's reported to be.

It's hard to believe this place was once an abandoned holiday resort buried in sandstorms for years. The smuggler lead must have put in some real effort to transform it into this haven, all to lure in illegal immigrants. Perhaps these warm welcome is just another carefully crafted illusion.
Even stranger is the absence of the severe contamination the Outland Affairs Bureau warned you about. All you see here are simple folks living in a perfect town.
You adopt an unassuming demeanor, graciously responding to the townsfolk's greetings. As the greetings continue, you cautiously begin probing for information about "human smuggling"...

options: How do I get to DisCity?
I have business with Vautour Bleu.

steps.content: You see, I've just got here and have no idea how to get to DisCity. I'd be grateful if anyone could offer some tips.
Just as you prepare to double down on your act, fingers brushing against the fake ID provided by the Outland Affairs Bureau, a large hand suddenly grabs your shoulder.

steps.speaker: Tipsy Drunkard
steps.content: Hey, anyone who makes it to Désir is family! Cut out the fancy talk. You're only the second one—besides me of course—to cross the WhiteSands alone to get here. You got guts, kid! We oughta throw you a damn welcome party for that!

steps.speaker: Townie A
steps.content: You're just looking for an excuse to get drunk!

steps.speaker: Townie C
steps.content: You're headed to DisCity too? It's a great place... Well, of course, Désir is a nice place too.

To your surprise, no one seems to shy away from talking about DisCity. The townsfolk carry on with cheerful banter, discussing "going to DisCity" as casually as the weather. Your earlier caution seems out of place.

Is this really the notorious illegal immigrant hub that's been giving the Outland Affairs Bureau such a headache? As you're grappling with this, a chime of a bicycle bell snaps you back to the moment.

steps.speaker: Amiable Girl
steps.content: Don't mind them. They just love any excuse for a get-together.

steps.speaker: Amiable Girl
steps.content: You're looking for Miss Vautour Bleu, right? I'm afraid she just left with her caravan. But if you don't mind, I'd be happy to show you around.
[Dove's portrait]
[Inside the town's inn]

steps.speaker: Dove
steps.content: Please, just call me Dove. I heard you were asking Primrose for directions earlier. Sorry but her best friend, Sheila, left for DisCity with the caravan just a few days ago, so she's been a bit down. Please excuse her.
No worries, I understand completely. Besides, everyone here has been incredibly welcoming.
Arms filled with local treats offered by the townsfolk, you follow Dove into what appears to be an ordinary house.

steps.speaker: Dove
steps.content: I'm sorry you didn't arrive at the best time. The caravan just left on urgent business, and Alba is busy preparing for a performance today, so I'll be your makeshift landlady for now. As for your questions about getting to DisCity, I'm afraid we'll have to wait till our hostess comes back.
Your arrival seems to surprise no one. Dove simply nods to a man basking downstairs as she leads you up. There's no request for identification or exchange of keys. She guides you upstairs casually.

steps.speaker: Dove
steps.content: This room is yours now. Please feel free to use it during your stay in Désir.

You push the door open and are pleasantly surprised by the room's decoration. It's clean and tidy, with windows on two sides. Sunlight filters through the lush branches outside, bathing the space with a warm, inviting glow.

steps.speaker: Dove
steps.content: Here's the bedding, washing tools, and even some fresh datura flowers... Yes, perfect! If you need anything else, just call out the window. As you've seen, folks here are nosy but helpful. We're fortunate in Désir—thanks to Miss Vautour Bleu and her caravan, we never have to worry about the living basics.

Not having to worry about food or water in the middle of WhiteSands? It sounds almost too good to be true. Noticing your doubting look, Dove's smile softens as she gently sets your luggage beside the bed.

steps.speaker: Dove
steps.content: If you're worried about money, please don't be. Miss Vautour Bleu will include your living expenses here in Désir as part of your fare to DisCity, all at a very fair price.

steps.speaker: Dove
steps.content: If your're really that hard up, you can take up some gigs at the bakery, diner, or this inn. That way, you can save up enough money for your trip. Or, if you'd like, you could also do a mail carrier job like me!
Dove's eyes brighten as she pats her messenger bag with pride.
So Miss Vautour Bleu offers job opportunities as well?

steps.speaker: Dove
steps.content: Of course. Miss Vautour Bleu knows how grueling the journey across WhiteSands can be. She's made this place a safe haven for all travelers.

Cheap food and lodging, no worries about basic necessities, and even job opportunities—it's exactly like the ads you found on the dark web and across WhiteSands. It's almost like a charity. If a free lunch like this were real, why would you have to be pulling all-nighters at the Bureau...
Noticing your silence, Dove leans in closer, her tone softer.

steps.speaker: Dove
steps.content: Désir... is a strange place, isn't it?
Hmm?

steps.speaker: Dove
steps.content: Nobody asks where you're from. Nobody questions your intentions. They just let you stay, just like that.
Her voice suddenly drops low, barely audible. The brim of her hat casts a shadow over her face, and an eerie silence fills over the room.
Is there a flaw in your disguise? But before you can react, Dove lifts her head, her smile returning, warm and genuine.

steps.speaker: Dove
steps.content: That's right, this is exactly what Désir is all about. People here don't need to know each other's past—it's the future that matters. Everyone here shares the same dream, and now you're part of it...
Dove walks to the window and pushes it open, letting in a rush of fresh air with floral fragrance that makes the gauze curtains flutter.

steps.speaker: Dove
steps.content: We'll all make it to DisCity and live out our dreams!

Following her gaze, you take in the scene below—this miniature society is bustling amid the greenery. The bakery is filling the air with a rich, enticing aroma. Bathed in sunlight, the town appears even cozier than before.

steps.speaker: Dove
steps.content: I'll be on the go. If you have any more questions, you can wait for your neighbor across the way. She'll help you.
[Peek through the window]

steps.speaker: Dove
steps.content: Yes, you're quite lucky, living right across from Miss Vautour Bleu. This room has the best view and the most convenient location... That is to say, it's the closest you can get to a brighter morrow.

Dove leaves. You watch from the window as she walks away. Downstairs, an elderly woman is basking in the sun with her dog. As Dove passes by, she pauses to gently pet the dog's head before continuing on her way.
Live out our dreams, huh...

Désir offers a quality of life that most Syndicans wouldn't dare to dream of—no gang shootouts, no Corruptor weapons, even no struggles for basic survival. What an illusion this smuggler has created about DisCity, that makes these immigrants here yearn for that distant land.

Still, you can't shake the feeling that this entire town might be just an elaborate show. As you mull over the clues at hand, you remain on high alert. Against the picturesque surroundings, you begin thoroughly inspecting your lodgings.

You find no listening devices or traces of Mania in the room. It's just an ordinary inn, and the townspeople have accepted your presence without any question. The identity-concealing props in your luggage, provided by the Outland Affairs Bureau, seem almost unnecessary.
A gentle breeze rustles the leaves outside your window, carrying with it the soothing sounds of daily life. For a fleeting moment, you almost forget that you're here on a mission, not a vacation.
Well, I guess I have no choice but to wait for her to come back.
You turn your gaze beyond the window. The tightly drawn blinds across the way silently announce Vautour Bleu's absence from her apartment.
Nightingale, notify the Outland Affairs Bureau that I've arrived in Désir and successfully settled in as a new visitor.
Vautour Bleu, the smuggler as they identified, is within my surveillance range. But she seems out of town for now.
Being this close to the target poses a risk of exposure. As a precaution, I'll initiate all future communications. Tell the FAC to stand by until further notice.
I haven't found out much regarding the severe contamination yet, but there is one peculiarity worth noting...
[Dark alley] [Monster]
When I first arrived in Désir, I heard some unusual whispers...
<color=#fb9259>Beware... You must beware...</color>

While Désir bustles with excitement for the newcomer, an unfinished letter lies unnoticed in a shadowy corner. On it, the neat handwriting trails off into two hurriedly scrawled lines—the last words of a solitary soul whose hope has run dry.
